title: GreenKabadi
summary: Doorstep scrap pickup website for Siliguri, with published rates, a booking path, and search-ready local pages.
description: GreenKabadi (greenkabadi.in) lets homes, shops, and institutions in Siliguri sell scrap from their doorstep. The site shows today's rates, explains verified weighing and digital receipts, and points visitors to book a pickup.
imageAlt: GreenKabadi homepage with the headline Sell your scrap, material types for metal, electronics, paper and plastic, and a Book a Pickup button
highlights: Homepage for doorstep pickup of metal, electronics, paper, and plastic
Today's indicative per-kg rates for iron, aluminium, e-waste, paper, and plastic
How-it-works path: book, collect, weigh, and pay with a digital receipt
Business and institutional pickup pages for shops, offices, apartments, and healthcare
In-page language switcher for English, Hindi, Bengali, and Nepali
App section with a Google Play badge and an App Store coming-soon state
Dedicated pages for rates, materials, areas, FAQ, about, contact, privacy, terms, and account deletion
seo: Prerendered HTML so the headline, rates, and FAQ are in the first response
Unique title and meta description, canonical URL, and index,follow robots rules
Open Graph and Twitter cards with a 1200 by 630 image and alt text
FAQPage, LocalBusiness, and WebSite structured data for Siliguri
hreflang for English and x-default, plus geo.region IN-WB
Descriptive image alt text and a crawlable footer to every public page
